mechanism: Tranylcypromine may potentiate gentamicin's ototoxic and nephrotoxic effects through monoamine oxidase inhibition affecting catecholamine metabolism, and both drugs carry independent renal toxicity risks.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and periodic creatinine/BUN; assess for ototoxicity symptoms; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels; evaluate alternative antibiotics if possible.
